items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: She would always come from Brooklyn to visit me here.

ctx.x: In Detroit. She would always come from Brooklyn to visit me here. So she come -- I don't know how Victoria found me, but when she come, she -- and some kind of way, she found me. Some kind of way, she found me. And she went to -- come to my house and she say, "Sippie, you could go to London. They wants a blues singer in London." And the man I was going with named Buddy, his name's Buddy, and so I asked Buddy (unintelligible) go to London, I was going. I wasn't Buddy.
